name: Schwarzsee Kitzbühel
kurzbeschreibung: Moor lake about two kilometres west of Kitzbühel with the Städtisches Schwarzseebad, sunbathing lawns and views of the Kaisergebirge.
beschreibung:
Overview

Lake Schwarzsee rests as a picturesque moorland bathing tarn at 762 meters elevation, cradled amid rolling green meadows between glamorous Kitzbühel and the pastoral village of Reith. Spanning approximately 16 hectares with a maximum depth of seven meters, it ranks among the warmest and most scenic bathing lakes in all of Tyrol: sheltered within a sunny valley bowl, its nutrient-rich moor waters warm rapidly in high summer to comfortable temperatures between 24 and 26 °C. For generations, the peat-infused water has been celebrated for its skin-soothing and therapeutic properties, lending the lake its distinctive dark emerald hue. On calm summer mornings, when the jagged limestone ramparts of the Wilder Kaiser range mirror flawlessly across the glassy surface, Schwarzsee presents one of the most iconic postcard landscapes in the Austrian Alps.

Route & Requirements

Schwarzsee serves as an all-season recreational sanctuary for walkers, joggers, and holidaymakers. The signature outing is the level shoreline loop: extending roughly 2.5 kilometers, a manicured gravel and paved trail meanders through shaded lakeside groves, water-lily bays, and tranquil reed beds (walking time approx. 45 to 60 minutes, easy grade T1, fully accessible for wheelchairs and strollers). On the northeastern shore, the expansive municipal lido (Städtisches Seebad) features sunbathing lawns, historic timber piers, diving boards, children's play areas, and electric and pedal boat rentals. Stand-up paddleboarders enjoy serene morning conditions across the water. In cold winters, the frozen surface transforms into an open-air ice arena for ice skating, curling, and snow strolling. Casual sneakers suffice for walking the lake path. Leashed dogs are permitted on the walking trail, but excluded from the lido lawns and swimming areas.

Visit & Arrival

Transit access is effortless: ÖBB regional trains stop at the dedicated "Kitzbühel Schwarzsee" rail station, situated just a brief 3-minute stroll from the lakeside. Regular regional buses link Kitzbühel center and Kirchberg directly to the lake stop. Drivers follow the Inntal autobahn A12 (exit Wörgl-Ost) and the B170 federal road into Kitzbühel. Spacious pay parking lots are situated directly adjacent to the municipal lido.

Tips

Rent a whisper-quiet electric boat at the pier and cruise across the water to capture mirror-image photographs of the Wilder Kaiser and Kitzbüheler Horn. Unwind at the upscale lakeside bistro "Das Steghaus," savoring freshly prepared alpine trout or afternoon coffee and pastries directly over the water as twilight sets in.
preis: Kostenlos (Seebad Eintritt ca. 7 €, Parkplatz ca. 5 € pro Tag)
